title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Amphitheatre on 1985-09-07
lineage: Master PCM > DAW (via SEKD Prodif) > Wav > cdwav > flac
source: 90 X-Y Schoeps CMC441 & 10 ft spaced Schoeps CMC42s -> custom M118 x2 -> custom Oade mixer -> Oade MOD PCM-F1

ai_review.summary: Fine audience recording captures a magical, weather‑shifting performance that left the crowd spellbound.
ai_review.review: The Oade Brothers’ audience tape is clear and bright for most of the set, delivering an enjoyable listening experience. Reviewers describe the concert as a “magical show” with the band seemingly moving the weather through their music, ending on a beautiful late‑summer evening. No specific song complaints are noted, indicating a uniformly strong performance.

ai_rating.rationale: A single enthusiastic 5‑star review praises both the musical experience and the recording quality; with limited data confidence remains low.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and bright for much of the set; Oade Brothers’ recording noted as fine with no major issues reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The performance is described as weather‑like, moving from clear skies to dark swirling squalls and back to a gorgeous evening, indicating an engaging and dynamic set flow.
